summary: 2_Вебинары is the webinar broadcast pack. It has 6 ROOT comps, all 25 fps: four near-identical 16:9 holding screens and two 10-s social announcements (Анонс_Вебинар_1x1 at 1400×1400, Анонс_Вебинар_9x16). The holding screens are a 30-s looping 'Заставка' and a 5-min countdown 'Таймер', each in two variants: 'с вижуалом' (AI robot-arm video in a window) and 'со спикером' (cut-out photo plus name strips). Everything is built from 9 precomps: Logo, Логоблок с челкой, PATTERN RACK/_Animation, AI_анимация precomp/_1/_2, Спикер and Timer precomp. The look is a dark #222222 background with a stepped mint/green 'portal' panel and SB Sans Display titles, plus a logo header with a drifting vertical-hatch 'fringe', an arrow-cross line pattern that flickers on through fractal noise, a dot grid and a vector Telegram QR. Motion is only ambient: the file has just 11 keyframed properties (5 time-remap loops and 6 hand-keyed PORTAL mask paths) and 4 working expressions (hatch drift, noise evolution, a count-up timer, loopOut), and no text or logo animates in or out. Nothing is parametrized: there is no Essential Graphics and no controls. Strings are retyped in every comp, and the QR/caption plus an old webinar title exist only as outlines. Speaker strips are scaled by hand, the countdown is a count-up precomp played in reverse, and the 24-fps webinar AME presets don't match the 25-fps comps. The decoded report, renders and reusable decoders are in C:\dev\temp\claude\C--Users------Documents-Cloud-ru-Preset-plugin\b48e0614-1141-4125-9b74-d00eb767441b\scratchpad\work\web\: report.txt, analyze.py, render_shape.py, l7_zv.png (outlined title + caption), l7_qr2_crop.png (QR), logo_*.png, pattern_tiled.png, group_png_x3.png, and sheet_A_robotic_ar.png / sheet_Seedance_mp4.png. The shared frames/ contact sheets for this pack's .mp4 files are blank gray.

templates.parametrization_plan: Merge the four 16:9 ROOT comps into one master 'WEB_Screen_16x9'. It gets a Dropdown 'Layout' (Visual | Speaker) and Checkboxes 'Timer', 'QR' and 'Pattern'. The CONTROLS null exposes: Title (EGP Source Text in the 904×368 box, with an auto-fit expression on Scale: k = min(1, 368/sourceRectAtTime().height)); Tagline text; QR caption text; Portal colour (Color Control limited to brand tokens); Visual scale and offset sliders. Two Media Replacement slots: VISUAL (an 820×800 window holding the footage or precomp layer directly in the EG comp, looped with loopOut on Time Remap) and QR (PNG/SVG, defaulting to the Telegram QR still). Replace the PORTAL masks with a shape layer (2 rects + Merge Paths) whose step x = 268 + 150·sin(2π·time/period), with a Period slider defaulting to 30 s; this loops seamlessly at any length with no keys. A pure loop needs no Responsive Time; if a portal-wipe entrance of about 0.6 s is added, protect 0–1 s. Pr: a 30-s seamless 25p prerender of the background (portal + pattern + logo block + AI window) looped on V1, a light mogrt with title/QR/caption on V2, the music as sfx on A1, exported with the ame-preset Webinar_Zastavka. Ae: an ae-template with the same CONTROLS, imported by the panel. EGP setup and mogrt export can be scripted with JSX (Property.addToMotionGraphicsTemplateAs + CompItem.exportAsMotionGraphicsTemplate).

Random Seed carries a self-referencing expression, and the layers are 3D without a camera. The same Fractal-Noise reveal (with time*50) exists in 4_SMM_Pack.
templates.parametrization_plan: Build one 'CRU_Pattern_Grid' shape template at 1920×1080 with sliders for Cell (96 px default), Stroke (2/4 px), Colour and Columns/Rows. problems.detail: The AI clip 'A_robotic_arm_performing_minimal,_precise_technological_movements._The_scene_showcases_…Jeffrey_Milstei.mp4' has a name of about 250 characters, making its full path on this PC 322 characters (over the Windows MAX_PATH limit of 260). AE, Premiere and AME on Windows may fail to relink, collect or render it. Even the contact sheet named after it could not be opened from the scratchpad by path.
problems.fix: Before opening on Windows, rename it to 'AI_robot_arm_A_1440p24.mp4' (and 'Seedance.mp4' to 'AI_robot_arm_B_1440p24.mp4') and relink. Enforce media names of at most 60 ASCII characters in the plugin library.

problems.detail: There is no Essential Graphics anywhere (CIFO/CIF2/CIF3 are 'Untitled' in all 15 comps) and no Expression Controls. Every variable string is typed separately: title text sits in 6 comps, speaker text in 2, and the date in 2 different spellings ('25 ноября в 11:00' vs '25.11 в 11:00'). Nothing can be driven 'by button'.
problems.fix: Build two masters (WEB_Screen_16x9 and WEB_Announce with 1x1/9x16 children) around a CONTROLS null or DATA comp. Wire text through EGP and add Media Replacement slots. Set up EGP and export mogrts with JSX (Property.addToMotionGraphicsTemplateAs, CompItem.exportAsMotionGraphicsTemplate).

problems.detail: The four 16:9 ROOT comps share about 80 % of their layers (background, PORTAL, Логоблок loop, QR outlines, title) and have already drifted apart. Differences include label size (39.6 vs 35 px), strip layer names, pattern strip masks/positions (40 % at x=361 vs 20 % at x=764), portal key cycles (30 s vs 75 s) and shy flags. The two announcements are hand-kept copies with different colour logic.
problems.fix: Use a single master per family, with Dropdown 'Layout' (Visual | Speaker) and Checkbox 'Timer' for 16:9, and Theme (Dark | Mint) plus format children for the announcements.

problems.detail: 'Layer 7 Outlines' (Таймер с вижуалом) and 'Layer 7 Outlines 2' (the other three 16:9 comps) hold the Telegram QR (127×127, about 65 merge-path groups) and the caption 'Канал Cloud.ru в Telegram' as vector outlines. They also contain a disabled group 'Текст' (tdsb=0) holding the outlined title of an old webinar: 'Как повысить отказоустойчивость Kubernetes: мультикластерная архитектура на Karmada' (render: work/web/l7_zv.png).
problems.fix: Delete the 'Текст' group. Replace the block with a QR footage slot (still PNG/SVG, Media Replacement) plus live caption text, and name the layer 'QR_TELEGRAM'.

problems.detail: The countdown is a count-up Source Text expression in 'Timer precomp', made to count down by time-reversing its layer (ldta stretch −1, start 300 s, locked) in both timer comps. Consequences: the length cannot be changed, the first frame is probably blank (source time 300 is outside the precomp), the display starts at 4:59, the expression carries dead code, and the digits are proportional.
problems.fix: Use a non-reversed text layer with expression r = Minutes*60 + Seconds − (time − inPoint), driven by sliders. Add an 'End text' state and fixed-width digits. In Pr the panel sets the clip duration and the 'Minutes' parameter; do not apply Responsive Time to the clock.

problems.detail: Frame rates and sizes disagree across the pipeline. The webinar AME presets are 24 fps: 'Webinar_FullHD_5-10_24fps', 'Timer_3-5_24fps' and 'Zastavka_15-20_24fps' (ADBEVideoFPS 10584000000 ticks). Every comp is 25 fps, and the brand tokens say 1080p @25. The SMM presets are 1080×1080 / 1080×1920 @30, while Анонс 1x1 is 1400×1400 @25 and Анонс 9x16 is @25. The AI clips are 24p, and the music is 44.1 kHz against 48-kHz presets.
problems.fix: Decide on target fps and sizes (see questions). Then conform the comps or rename and fix the presets so that comp, mogrt and AME preset share one fps per delivery. Render the AI loop as a 25p mezzanine.

problems.detail: Nothing sizes itself to its text. Speaker strips ('Подложка_1/2/3' / 'Layer 4 Outlines 3/4', 'Layer 5 Outlines 2') are scaled in X by hand (167.3 / 101.8 / 125 %). The announcement row is held together by a parent chain through hidden 25-px 'save zone' squares. Text layers are scaled instead of using font size (206.6 % inside a 35 % parent, 69.4 %, 82.3 %, 103.8 % vertical). The 9x16 title box (1296 px) is wider than its 1080-px frame.
problems.fix: Use sourceRectAtTime-driven strips and rows with padX/Gap sliders, auto-hide empty lines, reset all text scales to 100 % with real font sizes, and keep box widths inside the safe margins.

problems.detail: The live content is heavy for MOGRT playback in Premiere. It includes 4K precomps scaled to 61.9–64 % (PATTERN RACK: a 27-copy repeater of a 30-group shape) and a 3840×2160 3D solid with Fractal Noise. The AI visual is two levels of nested precomps of h264 clips, and the timers run 300 s. The QR alone is about 65 merge-path groups.
problems.fix: For Pr, deliver backgrounds as 30-s seamless prerender loops (ProRes 4444 for alpha elements, H.264 or ProRes 422 for full-frame) and keep mogrts to light overlays (text, strips, QR, timer). Rebuild the pattern natively at 1080p.

problems.detail: The visual (AI clips of 13 MB + 18 MB) and the speaker PNG are nested footage, not replaceable. A mogrt would embed about 31 MB of AI video per template. The music cannot travel inside a mogrt at all, because AE-authored mogrts carry no audio.
problems.fix: Add Media Replacement slots for VISUAL, SPEAKER and QR, with default media as separate library items. Ship the music beds as sfx placed by the panel.

problems.detail: Leftover clutter across the file: a duplicate music layer L6 with audio off (Таймер с вижуалом); PORTAL Mask 3 identical to Mask 2 (Заставка с вижуалом); 14 PORTAL keys past 30 s in both 30-s comps; a hidden 3D 'Dark Gray Solid 2' and unneeded 3D switches in PATTERN RACK_Animation; matte-only pink fills on 'Shape Layer 1/2'; layer spans copied from 300-s comps (text 300 s inside 30-s comps, PATTERN RACK 310–317 s, Logo layers 921 s).
problems.fix: Delete or trim as listed in cleanup_actions, and A/B the 3D switch removal visually before committing.

problems.detail: Most AV layers have no name. Shape layers keep Illustrator/Figma names ('Layer 7 Outlines 2', 'Layer 4 Outlines 3', 'Layer 34/Frame 1[851040355-851040356] Outlines 2'). There is a typo ('Fractal Noice'), duplicate solid names ('Dark Gray Solid 1' ×2, 'Dark Gray Solid 2' ×2), and footage named 'Group 2131327780.png'.
problems.fix: Adopt one naming scheme: BG / VISUAL / SPEAKER / LOGO_BLOCK / PATTERN / TIMER / MUSIC / QR_TELEGRAM / PLASHKA_NAME / ROLE1 / ROLE2 / CONTROLS, and use descriptive media names.

problems.detail: The project uses the legacy 'extendscript' expression engine. All 9 expressions (5× loopOut(), Fractal Evolution 'effect("Fractal Noise")(24) ⏎ time*40', Random Seed 'effect("Fractal Noise")(28)' referencing itself, Repeater Offset '-100 + time*0.5', and the timer) parse fine under JavaScript, but they carry leftover lines and dead variables.
problems.fix: Switch Project Settings → Expressions to JavaScript. Reduce Evolution to 'time*40', delete the Random Seed expression, and rewrite the timer.

problems.detail: Colours have drifted from the brand tokens: portals use #8EE7BB, #6CDFA6 and #26D07C (three different fills); greys use #ECECEC and #EEEEEE instead of the token gray #F2F2F2; arrows are #C2C2C2 instead of the arrow token #8C959E; the wordmark is #F8F8F8. The 16:9 mint portal covers about 70 % of the frame, against the rule 'green fill ≤ 30 % of a content frame'. Colours come from a mix of text-document colours and Fill-effect overrides.
problems.fix: Define a token list (with an explicit approved mint tint if needed) and drive every colour through Color Controls on CONTROLS, removing Fill overrides.

problems.detail: 'Музыка вебинар 5 минут.mp3' is 296.34 s against 300-s timer comps (layer out 297.52 s), so the last ≈3.7 s are silent. Both beds are 44.1 kHz, and there is a duplicate music layer in Таймер с вижуалом.
problems.fix: Conform the bed to exactly 300 s (or align its end to 0:00) at 48 kHz and ship it as sfx. Provide a loopable 30-s bed for the Заставка.

problems.detail: The template ships a real person's photo ('Смирнов Илья_v1_20.03 1.png') next to a different name ('Александр Константинов'). The AI clips are named after their prompt, and the cube in them shows a 2×2-pane glyph resembling a third-party logo.
problems.fix: Use a neutral placeholder cut-out as the default speaker, and get the AI visuals cleared or regenerated before they become library defaults.

problems.detail: Text uses SBSansDisplay-Regular (15 runs) and SBSansDisplay-Semibold (1 run), which are not on Adobe Fonts. The PC has system fonts with matching PostScript names, version 1.002. The text documents reference 'Version 1.000' from the Mac, so line breaks may shift slightly. Every Premiere seat needs these fonts installed for the mogrts to work.
problems.fix: Have the plugin check for the fonts before inserting, and re-check line breaks after the first open on the PC.

problems.detail: Footage is stored with absolute Mac paths (/Volumes/T7_Black/_Video/2_Вебинары/(Footage)/Folder/…) that do not exist on Windows. The aliases use ascendcount_base=1 / target=4, the identical (Footage)/Folder/{Img,Music,Video} tree is next to the .aep, and this pack has no NFD names.
problems.fix: A relative relink should happen automatically on open (after the long-name rename). If it does not, Replace Footage once on (Footage)/Folder.

problems.detail: The shared audit (aep_audit.py) under-reports for every pack. It shows 'effects: {}' because effect instances are LIST 'sspc' after their tdmn and only tdgp is recorded; this file actually has Fill on about 20 layers, Fractal Noise ×1 and Lumetri ×1. It also skips masks entirely, because 'ADBE Mask Atom' is followed by an 'mkif' chunk before its LIST, so the 6 animated mask paths are missed. Decoded ldta offsets: start, in and out at 12/16, 20/24 and 28/32 (s32/u32 pairs); stretch numerator at 8, denominator at 108; track-matte type byte at 107 (1 alpha, 2 alpha inverted, 3 luma); layer type at 128 (0 AV, 3 text, 4 shape); parent id at 132; matte layer id at 160; flag byte 39 (bit0 video, bit1 audio, bit2 fx); byte 38 bit 0x04 = 3D. Keyframe time = s32/25600 at each ldat record start, and tdsb bit0 = group enabled. The contact sheets for .mp4 sources (both webinar clips and the SMM kling clip) are blank gray.
problems.fix: Use work/web/analyze.py and render_shape.py for the deep pass on the other packs, and regenerate mp4 contact sheets with a plain fps/scale/tile chain.

animation_patterns.name: Portal step drift
animation_patterns.description: A mask-path morph on PORTAL Mask 1: the right edge of the left block cycles 118 → 417 → 229 → (402 →) 118 px in layer space (about ±150 px), on bezier keys with about 33 % influence. Intros use a 30-s period (keys at 0 / 9 / 21.32 / 29.92 s, plus 14 leftover keys up to 174.6 s); timers use a 75-s period (17 keys, 4 cycles over 300 s). The 1x1 variant instead 'breathes' two notches on linear keys at 0 → 5 → 9.96 s (+109 px on the top-right notch, +86 px on the bottom-left).
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx 'CRU_Portal_StepDrift': an expression on shape-rect size/position with Amplitude / Period / Phase sliders, looping seamlessly, replacing the keyed masks. Pr gets prerendered loops.

animation_patterns.name: Hatch fringe drift
animation_patterns.description: Repeater Offset = -100 + time*0.5 (0.5 copies/s = 12.5 px/s at 25-px spacing, 200 copies) inside a 6-s precomp. The precomp is looped in each parent by Time Remap (2 linear keys, 0 → 5.96 s) + loopOut(). It is seamless because 6 s × 0.5 = 3 whole copies.
where_used: Логоблок с челкой (inside all four 16:9 comps)
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx 'CRU_Hatch_Drift': a shape layer with Spacing / Speed (constrained to k·spacing/period) / Stroke / Copies sliders.

animation_patterns.name: Pattern shimmer (noise-revealed grid)
animation_patterns.description: The PATTERN RACK grid is luma-matted by a 3840×2160 3D solid running Fractal Noise: Fractal Type #5, Noise Type Block, Contrast 400, Brightness −100, Scale 225, Evolution = time*40 °/s. The result is random pattern cells flickering on and off. The same recipe appears in 4_SMM_Pack with time*50.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ae-template 'CRU_Pattern_Shimmer' (grid + noise matte, Speed / Density sliders), plus an ffx variant (Fractal Noise + Set Matte) and alpha prerender loops for Pr.

animation_patterns.name: Static pattern strip
animation_patterns.description: The PATTERN RACK precomp is masked to a strip (40 %×10 % or 20 %×10 % of the 4K comp) and scaled to 61.9 %. It has no motion.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: still (SVG strip), plus the 'CRU_Pattern_Grid' ae-template with Columns × Rows sliders.

animation_patterns.name: Precomp loop via Time Remap
animation_patterns.description: Time Remap with 2 linear keys (0 → duration minus 1 frame) + loopOut('cycle'). Used to stretch the 6-s logo block and the 30.16-s AI loop across 30-s and 300-s comps.

animation_patterns.name: AI clip concatenation + speed-up
animation_patterns.description: Two 10-s 24p AI clips are concatenated, then two copies are stretched to 74.75 % and 75.35 % (≈1.33× speed) to make a 30.16-s loop. They use 50-px feathered masks and a Lumetri match on Seedance (Temperature 3, Tint 1, Exposure 0.1), with no frame blending.
where_used: AI_анимация precomp / _1 / _2 → CONTENT and the announcements
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: prerender: a single 25p loop file. A preset adds nothing here.

animation_patterns.name: Countdown
animation_patterns.description: A Source Text expression counts up (m:ss from floor(time)), and the precomp layer is time-reversed (stretch −100 %, start 300 s) to make it count down. There are no controls.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx 'CRU_Countdown_mmss' (Minutes / Seconds / Leading zero / End text), plus a 'Countdown' mogrt for Pr.

animation_patterns.name: Spacing rig (save-zone chain)
animation_patterns.description: 25-px red-stroked squares (hidden, fill disabled) are parented in a chain with the text and arrows ('Вебинар' → save zone → Strelka → save zone → date …). They act as manual gap guides for a horizontal meta row.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx 'CRU_AutoRow': a sourceRectAtTime-based horizontal stack with a Gap slider, replacing the squares.

animation_patterns.name: Static holding layout (no entrances)
animation_patterns.description: No text, logo or strip has entrance or exit keyframes; everything is visible from frame 0. 'Life' comes only from the ambient patterns above and the AI video.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: Optional brand entrance presets from the shared library (premium entrance, portal wipe, strip wipe). If they are added, protect the intro and outro with Responsive Design – Time (0–1 s and the last 0.5 s) on stretchable mogrts.
